reason: README clearly identifies this as a DSH Web theme plugin focused on Endfield-inspired colors, typography, square UI styling, configurable accents, optional watermark and contour backgrounds, and loading animation.

summaries.zh: 一款为 DSH Web 界面设计的终末地官网风格主题，提供工业编辑风配色、直角组件、强调色切换及可选背景效果。
summaries.en: An Endfield-inspired DSH Web theme offering industrial editorial styling, square UI components, accent-color switching, and optional background effects.

capabilities: Overrides DSH theme tokens and injects global interface styles
Provides persistent local display settings via localStorage
Renders optional animated contour-line background on a canvas
